newsitem.title: CHINA: Building begun on foreign-owned China power plant.
newsitem.headline: Building begun on foreign-owned China power plant.

text.p: Construction of a wholly foreign-funded 3,100 megawatt thermal power plant is in full swing in China's southeastern province of Fujian, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
The $660 million Meizhou Bay Thermal Power Plant was being jointly built by International Electric Co of the United States and a Hong Kong company, Xinhua said but gave no details.
The plant, approved by the State Planning Commission, would be in foreign hands for 23 years before being handed to China, it said but did not elaborate.
It was designed by the Bechtel Group Inc of the United States and a Chinese provincial design institute under environmental standards set by the World Bank, it said.

The plant would be built in stages, with a 700 megawatt first phase expected to go into operation within three years, Xinhua said, adding the plant would eventually have a total installed capacity of 3,100 megawatts.
Authorities in Fujian hoped to have 11,000 megawatts in installed capacity in the coastal province by 2000, it said but did not give current capacity.
